events.title: Frankfurt Dippemess Funfair — Saturday
events.description: Frankfurt's historic funfair dating back to the 14th century. Roller coasters, thrill rides, bumper cars, shooting galleries, candy floss. The name comes from the pottery (Dippe) traditionally sold here. Late-night opening with extended hours.

events.title: Mainz Saturday Flea Market

events.title: Frankfurt Free Walking Tour

events.title: Friedberger Platz Organic Market

events.title: Ebbelwei Express Tram Ride
events.description: Frankfurt's famous apple wine tram. Ride a historic tram while enjoying Apfelwein and pretzels. Live accordion music. Departs hourly from the Zoo.

events.title: Mainz Wine Market — Sunday
events.description: Sunday continuation of the Mainz Wine Market. Relaxed afternoon wine tasting with views of the Rhine. Special emphasis on organic and biodynamic wines.

events.title: Palmengarten Sunday Concert Series

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo — Sunday Family Program
events.description: Sunday at the zoo with extended family programming. Guided tours, animal encounters, and the popular sea lion feeding at 11:00 and 15:00.

events.title: Berger Straße Festival — Sunday

events.title: Frankfurt Dippemess Funfair — Sunday

events.title: Palmengarten Sunday Visit

events.title: Ebbelwei Express Sunday Tram Ride
events.description: Sunday apple wine tram ride. A fun way to explore Frankfurt while enjoying traditional Ebbelwei. Hourly from Frankfurt Zoo.

events.title: O'Reilly's English Pub Quiz

events.location: O'Reilly's Irish Pub, Am Salzhaus 4, 60311 Frankfurt

events.title: Bingo Night at The Cast Iron Bar

events.title: Jazzkeller Frankfurt — Tuesday Night Jam Session

events.location: Jazzkeller Frankfurt, Kleine Bockenheimer Str. 18a, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Städel Museum — Regular Opening
events.description: The Städel Museum, one of Germany's most important art museums, houses a world-class collection spanning seven centuries. See masterpieces by Dürer, Rembrandt, Botticelli, Vermeer, Monet, Renoir, Picasso, and Richter. The collection spans Early Renaissance through contemporary art.

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle — Current Exhibition
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle, one of Europe's foremost contemporary art venues. Located on the historic Römerberg square. Features groundbreaking exhibitions of modern and contemporary art. Previous shows have featured Frida Kahlo, Edvard Munch, Yoko Ono, and Ai Weiwei.

events.title: Senckenberg Naturmuseum — Regular Opening
events.description: One of Europe's largest natural history museums. See the famous 'Tristan' T-Rex skeleton, the largest dinosaur exhibition in Germany. Complete skeletons of Diplodocus, Iguanodon, and Triceratops. Interactive fossil-digging area for children.

events.title: Mainz Weekly Wine Tasting at Haus des Weines
events.description: Weekly wine tasting session at Mainz's Haus des Weines. Sample 6 Rheinhessen wines each week with expert sommelier guidance. Cheese and bread pairings included. A wonderful introduction to the region's wines.

events.title: Kleinmarkthalle Frankfurt — Daily Food Market

events.description: Festive Christmas Eve service at the Festhalle. Community carol singing, readings, and a message of peace. Open to all denominations. Free entry.

events.title: Alte Oper — Christmas Eve Chamber Music
events.description: Intimate Christmas Eve chamber music concert in the Mozart Hall. Works by Mozart, Tchaikovsky, and traditional Christmas pieces. A peaceful musical start to the holiday.

events.title: Frankfurt — Christmas Eve at the Cathedral
events.description: Christmas Eve mass at Frankfurt's Kaiserdom (St. Bartholomew's Cathedral). Solemn midnight mass with full choir and organ. The cathedral is spectacularly decorated. All are welcome.

events.title: Frankfurt City Runners — Thursday Group Run
events.description: Free weekly 5-8km group run through Frankfurt's central parks and along the Main River. All paces welcome. Meet at Grüneburgpark. Post-run social at a nearby café.

events.title: Waxy's Irish Pub — Thursday Quiz Night
events.description: Weekly English-language quiz. General knowledge, picture rounds, music quiz. Teams of 2-6. Prizes for winners.
events.location: Waxy's Irish Pub, Mainzer Landstraße 95, 60329 Frankfurt

events.title: Kleinmarkthalle Frankfurt — Friday Fish Market Special
events.description: Frankfurt's iconic indoor food market. Fridays are especially lively with the freshest fish and seafood deliveries from the North Sea. Traditional Frankfurter specialties and international delicacies. The busiest day of the week at the market.

events.title: Batschkapp Friday Night Concert
events.description: Frankfurt's legendary live music club Batschkapp presents international rock, indie, punk, and alternative acts. Known for launching major bands and its intimate, high-energy atmosphere. One of Germany's most iconic music venues.

events.title: Gibson Club — Friday Night Party
events.description: Frankfurt's premier nightclub Gibson Club on the Zeil. Multi-level venue with state-of-the-art sound system. Top international DJs spinning house, electronic, and techno. VIP areas and sophisticated crowd.

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle — Weekend Exhibition
events.description: Weekend visit to the Schirn Kunsthalle. Special guided tours at 15:00. The museum shop offers excellent art books and design objects. Located in the heart of Frankfurt's historic centre.

events.title: Tanzhaus West — Friday Night Opening
events.description: Friday night at Tanzhaus West. Warm-up for the weekend with resident DJs and guest artists. A more relaxed vibe than Saturday with an earlier crowd.

events.title: Robert Johnson — Friday Night Opening
events.description: Friday night at Robert Johnson. Warm-up for the weekend with resident DJs and guest artists. A more relaxed vibe than Saturday with an earlier crowd.

events.description: Friday night at Pik Dame. Warm-up for the weekend with resident DJs and guest artists. A more relaxed vibe than Saturday with an earlier crowd.
events.location: Pik Dame, Große Eschenheimer Str. 11, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Christmas Day — Open-air Ice Skating
events.description: Christmas Day ice skating at the Opernplatz ice rink. A Christmas tradition for Frankfurt families. Skate rentals available. Hot chocolate and mulled wine served. Open 12:00-20:00.

events.title: Silbergold Friday Afterwork Party
events.description: Frankfurt's legendary Friday afterwork party. DJs, cocktail specials, international crowd. The perfect start to the weekend.

events.title: Mainz Saturday Flea Market at Südring
events.description: Mainz's biggest flea market with over 200 vendors selling vintage furniture, retro electronics, antique books, vinyl records, toys, clothing, and collectibles. Early birds find the best deals. Food stalls serve grilled sausages, coffee, and fresh pretzels.

events.title: Frankfurt Farmers' Market at Konstablerwache
events.description: The largest weekly farmers' market in Frankfurt's city centre. Regional farmers sell seasonal fruits, vegetables, flowers, fresh eggs, honey, artisan breads, cheeses, and cold cuts. Cooking demonstrations, live music, and children's activities. The perfect place to shop for a weekend feast.

events.title: Mainz Market Breakfast at Cathedral Square
events.description: A beloved Mainz tradition every Saturday. Farmers bring fresh organic produce, artisan cheeses, free-range eggs, and freshly baked bread. Local vintners pour Riesling and Silvaner for an early sparkling Frühschoppen. Live acoustic guitar or jazz duo from 10:00. Breakfast platters available.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt — Saturday Evening Performance
events.description: The acclaimed Oper Frankfurt presents its Saturday evening performance. One of Germany's leading opera houses with world-class productions ranging from classical repertoire to contemporary works. The modern auditorium features exceptional acoustics.

events.title: Schauspiel Frankfurt — Saturday Evening Performance
events.description: The main Saturday evening performance at Schauspiel Frankfurt. Features the theatre's acclaimed ensemble in a diverse repertoire from Shakespeare to modern German drama. Pre-show discussions available.

events.title: Alte Oper Frankfurt — Saturday Concert
events.description: The magnificent Alte Oper, one of Europe's most beautiful concert halls, presents its Saturday evening concert. The neo-Renaissance building's Grosser Saal with 2,450 seats offers exceptional acoustics. Program ranges from classical orchestral works to jazz and world music.

events.title: Brotfabrik Saturday Night Concert
events.description: Saturday night live concert at Brotfabrik Frankfurt. Features independent and alternative artists from Germany and abroad. The intimate venue in Bockenheim is known for its excellent acoustics and grassroots atmosphere.

events.title: Künstlerhaus Mousonturm — Weekend Performance
events.description: Weekend performance at Frankfurt's leading contemporary arts venue. Cutting-edge theatre, dance, and interdisciplinary performances from international artists and collectives.

events.title: Batschkapp Saturday Night Gig
events.description: Saturday night live music at Frankfurt's legendary Batschkapp. Features both established international touring acts and the best of the German independent music scene. The venue's famous mosh pit has seen decades of rock history.

events.title: Zoom Frankfurt — Saturday Night Concert
events.description: Zoom Frankfurt, one of the city's premier live music venues, hosts international and national touring acts. The versatile space hosts everything from indie rock and electronic to hip-hop and world music. Excellent sound system and intimate atmosphere.

events.title: Gibson Club — Saturday Night Mega Party
events.description: Saturday night at Frankfurt's most glamorous nightclub. World-renowned DJs, spectacular light shows, and multiple dance floors. The premier destination for Frankfurt's nightlife scene.

events.title: Städel Museum — Saturday Special
events.description: Reduced admission on Saturdays (€12). The Städel's world-class collection of 3,000 paintings, 600 sculptures, and 100,000 works on paper. Special exhibitions highlight major themes in art history. Guided tours available.

events.title: Senckenberg Museum — Family Saturday
events.description: Special family programming at the Senckenberg Museum. Guided tours for families, hands-on fossil workshops, and the spectacular dinosaur hall. The 'Tristan' T-Rex and giant shark jaw are highlights.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo — Saturday Family Day
events.description: Saturday at Frankfurt Zoo with special keeper talks, animal feeding demonstrations, and children's educational activities. The petting zoo is open for children to interact with goats and sheep.

events.title: Zoo Frankfurt — Winter Wonderland Light Trail
events.description: The zoo transforms with thousands of lights, illuminated animal sculptures, and a magical light trail. Hot chocolate and roasted chestnuts. A magical post-Christmas family outing.

events.title: English Theatre Frankfurt — Saturday Performance
events.description: Saturday evening performance at the English Theatre. Post-show discussions with the cast available. Full bar service in the elegant foyer.

events.title: Staatstheater Mainz — Saturday Performance
events.description: Mainz State Theatre presents world-class theatre, opera, and ballet in one of Germany's most beautiful historic theatres. Repertoire spans Shakespeare to contemporary German playwrights. Neo-baroque facade and stunning Art Deco interior.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt — Christmas Concert
events.description: Festive Christmas concert by the Frankfurt Opera ensemble and Museumsorchester. Classical masterpieces, traditional carols, and seasonal favorites.

events.title: Tanzhaus West — Saturday Night Club
events.description: Saturdays at Tanzhaus West, one of Frankfurt's premier nightlife spots. International DJs, cutting-edge sound systems, and a stylish crowd. Late-night partying until dawn.

events.title: Robert Johnson — Saturday Night Club
events.description: Saturdays at Robert Johnson, one of Frankfurt's premier nightlife spots. International DJs, cutting-edge sound systems, and a stylish crowd. Late-night partying until dawn.

events.description: Saturdays at MTW Club, one of Frankfurt's premier nightlife spots. International DJs, cutting-edge sound systems, and a stylish crowd. Late-night partying until dawn.

events.description: Saturdays at Yachthaus, one of Frankfurt's premier nightlife spots. International DJs, cutting-edge sound systems, and a stylish crowd. Late-night partying until dawn.

events.title: Pik Dame — Saturday Night Club
events.description: Saturdays at Pik Dame, one of Frankfurt's premier nightlife spots. International DJs, cutting-edge sound systems, and a stylish crowd. Late-night partying until dawn.
events.location: Pik Dame, Große Eschenheimer Str. 11, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt — Boxing Day Concert at Alte Oper
events.description: Traditional Boxing Day concert at the Alte Oper. A festive program of classical favorites. A perfect way to spend the second day of Christmas.

events.title: Mainz Saturday Flea Market
events.description: Mainz's biggest flea market at Südring. Over 200 vendors with vintage furniture, electronics, books, vinyl, clothing, and collectibles. Early birds find the best deals. Food and coffee available.

events.title: Frankfurt Free Walking Tour
events.description: Free 2.5-hour guided walking tour through Frankfurt's historic centre. See the Römer, Cathedral, Paulskirche, and banking district. Tips-based. English language.

events.title: Friedberger Platz Organic Market
events.description: Weekly organic farmers' market. Certified organic produce, free-range eggs, artisan bread, raw milk cheeses, natural wines.

events.title: Ebbelwei Express Tram Ride
events.description: Frankfurt's famous apple wine tram. Ride a historic tram while enjoying Apfelwein and pretzels. Live accordion music. Departs hourly from the Zoo.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt — Sunday Matinee
events.description: Sunday afternoon opera performance at the Oper Frankfurt. Reduced matinee prices make this an accessible way to experience world-class opera. Pre-show introduction to the opera's history and themes at 14:30.

events.title: Schauspiel Frankfurt — Sunday Matinee
events.description: Sunday afternoon theatre performance with special matinee pricing. A wonderful way to spend a Sunday afternoon experiencing world-class theatre in Frankfurt's cultural heart.

events.title: Alte Oper Frankfurt — Sunday Matinee Concert
events.description: Sunday afternoon concert at the magnificent Alte Oper. Reduced ticket prices for matinee performances. Features the Frankfurt Radio Symphony Orchestra and international guest artists.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo — Sunday Family Program
events.description: Sunday at the zoo with extended family programming. Guided tours, animal encounters, and the popular sea lion feeding at 11:00 and 15:00.

events.title: Zoo Frankfurt — Winter Wonderland continues
events.description: Second day of the winter light trail. Special children's program with storytelling and warm treats.

events.title: English Theatre Frankfurt — Sunday Matinee
events.description: Sunday matinee at Frankfurt's English-language theatre. Reduced matinee prices make this an accessible cultural outing. Pre-show brunch available at nearby cafes.

events.title: Staatstheater Mainz — Sunday Matinee
events.description: Sunday afternoon performance at the Mainz State Theatre. Special family-friendly programming, reduced ticket prices, and a relaxed matinee atmosphere.

events.title: Palmengarten Sunday Visit
events.description: Frankfurt's stunning botanical garden open for Sunday visits. Explore 22 hectares of exotic plants, tropical greenhouses, and the beautiful rose garden. Children's adventure playground. A peaceful Sunday escape.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo Sunday Family Program
events.description: Sunday at Frankfurt Zoo with special family programming. Keeper talks, animal feeding demonstrations, children's educational activities. The petting zoo is open. A perfect family day out.

events.title: Ebbelwei Express Sunday Tram Ride
events.description: Sunday apple wine tram ride. A fun way to explore Frankfurt while enjoying traditional Ebbelwei. Hourly from Frankfurt Zoo.

events.title: Kleinmarkthalle Frankfurt — Daily Food Market
events.description: Frankfurt's iconic indoor food market with over 60 permanent vendors. Fresh produce from around the world — Italian truffles, Middle Eastern spices, fresh seafood, artisan cheeses, exotic fruits. Enjoy Apfelwein at a standing table while sampling handmade sausages or freshly shucked oysters.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo — Weekday Visit
events.description: One of Germany's oldest and most renowned zoos (founded 1858). See the famous Grzimek House with nocturnal animals, Borgori Forest primate enclosure, Exotarium with sharks and crocodiles, and the newly renovated elephant park.

events.title: Zoo Frankfurt — Holiday Family Day
events.description: Between Christmas and New Year's special programming. Extended hours, extra keeper talks, and holiday-themed enrichment for the animals.

events.title: O'Reilly's English Pub Quiz
events.description: The legendary Monday night English-language pub quiz at O'Reilly's Irish Pub. Teams of 2-6 compete across eight rounds of general knowledge, music, movies, and current events. Prizes include rounds of drinks. Arrive early to secure a table.
events.location: O'Reilly's Irish Pub, Am Salzhaus 4, 60311 Frankfurt

events.title: Bingo Night at The Cast Iron Bar
events.description: Weekly English-language bingo night at The Cast Iron Bar in Sachsenhausen. Fun prizes, drink specials, and a lively social atmosphere. A great Monday night activity.
events.location: The Cast Iron Bar, Textorstraße 20, 60594 Frankfurt

events.title: Cinestar — Monday Original Version Film
events.description: Selected Hollywood and international films in their original English version at Cinestar. Comfortable seating, Dolby Atmos, and 4K projection. Reduced Monday ticket prices.

events.title: Between the Years — Family Ice Skating
events.description: Christmas holiday skating at Opernplatz. Music, games on ice, warm treats. Open 10:00-22:00.

events.title: Jazzkeller Frankfurt — Tuesday Night Jam Session
events.description: The legendary Jazzkeller Frankfurt's weekly Tuesday night jam session. The intimate basement venue has hosted Miles Davis, Louis Armstrong, and Dizzy Gillespie. Features a different house band each week, followed by open jam. Free for musicians bringing instruments.
events.location: Jazzkeller Frankfurt, Kleine Bockenheimer Str. 18a, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Städel Museum — Regular Opening
events.description: The Städel Museum, one of Germany's most important art museums, houses a world-class collection spanning seven centuries. See masterpieces by Dürer, Rembrandt, Botticelli, Vermeer, Monet, Renoir, Picasso, and Richter. The collection spans Early Renaissance through contemporary art.

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle — Current Exhibition
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle, one of Europe's foremost contemporary art venues. Located on the historic Römerberg square. Features groundbreaking exhibitions of modern and contemporary art. Previous shows have featured Frida Kahlo, Edvard Munch, Yoko Ono, and Ai Weiwei.

events.title: Senckenberg Naturmuseum — Regular Opening
events.description: One of Europe's largest natural history museums. See the famous 'Tristan' T-Rex skeleton, the largest dinosaur exhibition in Germany. Complete skeletons of Diplodocus, Iguanodon, and Triceratops. Interactive fossil-digging area for children.

events.title: Mainz Weekly Wine Tasting at Haus des Weines
events.description: Weekly wine tasting session at Mainz's Haus des Weines. Sample 6 Rheinhessen wines each week with expert sommelier guidance. Cheese and bread pairings included. A wonderful introduction to the region's wines.

events.title: Between the Years — Museum Slow Day
events.description: Many museums offer special slow looking tours. Palmengarten greenhouses provide warm winter escape.

events.title: Kleinmarkthalle Frankfurt — Daily Food Market
events.description: Frankfurt's iconic indoor food market with over 60 permanent vendors. Midweek deliveries bring the freshest catches. A paradise for food lovers with regional and international specialties.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt — Wednesday Evening Recital
events.description: The Oper Frankfurt presents a mid-week recital in its stunning modern auditorium. Features the acclaimed Frankfurt Opera ensemble in intimate chamber opera and art song performances. Pre-show talks offer insights into the program. The elegant foyer bar serves champagne and canapés during intermission.

events.title: Schauspiel Frankfurt — Wednesday Performance
events.description: Schauspiel Frankfurt, one of Germany's leading theatres, presents its mid-week performance. Housed in a striking modern building on Willy-Brandt-Platz, the theatre produces an innovative repertoire from classics to contemporary works.

events.title: Brotfabrik Open Mic Night
events.description: Weekly open mic night at Brotfabrik, Frankfurt's beloved cultural centre in Bockenheim. Musicians, poets, comedians, and storytellers take the stage for 10-minute slots. Sign-up at 19:30. Craft beers and Apfelwein at the bar.

events.title: English Theatre Frankfurt — Wednesday Performance
events.description: One of the largest English-language theatres in continental Europe. International casts perform contemporary plays, classic dramas, and comedies. The intimate 300-seat theatre ensures every seat has a great view.

events.title: HR-Sendesaal Lunch Concert
events.description: Free lunchtime concert by the HR Symphony Orchestra. 45-minute classical program. Open to the public. 13:00-13:45.

events.title: Jazzkeller Frankfurt — Thursday Night Concert
events.description: Thursday night concert at Frankfurt's legendary Jazzkeller. Features touring international jazz artists and acclaimed local ensembles. Late-night atmosphere in the historic vaulted cellar.
events.location: Jazzkeller Frankfurt, Kleine Bockenheimer Str. 18a, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Künstlerhaus Mousonturm — Thursday Performance
events.description: Mousonturm, Frankfurt's leading venue for contemporary performing arts. Features avant-garde theatre, contemporary dance, performance art, and interdisciplinary works from international artists.

events.title: Frankfurt English Comedy Open Mic
events.description: Frankfurt's English-language comedy night at Orange Peel in Sachsenhausen. Seasoned comedians and brave first-timers take the stage for 5-7 minute sets. Sign-up at 19:30. Craft beers and cocktails available.

events.title: Städel Museum — Thursday Extended Hours
events.description: The Städel Museum stays open until 21:00 on Thursdays. Evening lighting creates a special atmosphere in the galleries. Fewer visitors make for a more intimate experience with masterpieces spanning 700 years of art history.

events.title: Festhalle — New Year's Eve Gala
events.description: Spectacular New Year's Eve gala at the Festhalle. Multi-course dinner, live music and dancing, champagne at midnight, and a stunning fireworks display visible through the glass dome.

events.title: New Year's Eve at Frankfurt Römer
events.description: Spectacular New Year's Eve celebration on Frankfurt's Römerberg square. Live music stage, food and mulled wine stalls, countdown on giant LED screen, and breathtaking midnight fireworks display launched from the Main River bridges. Tens of thousands gather to welcome the new year.

events.title: Mainz New Year's Eve on the Rhine
events.description: New Year's Eve celebration on the Mainz Rhine riverbank. Live music at the Rheingoldhalle, food and champagne stalls, midnight fireworks over the Rhine with the illuminated citadel as backdrop.

events.title: Oper Frankfurt — New Year's Eve Gala
events.description: Gala New Year's Eve concert at the Oper Frankfurt. Champagne reception, operetta highlights, waltzes, and a festive countdown to midnight.

events.title: Alte Oper — New Year's Eve Concert
events.description: Grand New Year's Eve concert at the Alte Oper. Viennese waltzes, operetta highlights, and champagne at midnight. The most glamorous way to welcome the new year in Frankfurt.

events.title: Frankfurt City Runners — Thursday Group Run
events.description: Free weekly 5-8km group run through Frankfurt's central parks and along the Main River. All paces welcome. Meet at Grüneburgpark. Post-run social at a nearby café.

events.title: New Year's Eve — Frankfurt Party Cruise
events.description: New Year's Eve party cruise on the Main River. Dinner buffet, open bar, live band and DJ, and a front-row view of the midnight fireworks from the water. Dress code: elegant.

events.title: Waxy's Irish Pub — Thursday Quiz Night
events.description: Weekly English-language quiz. General knowledge, picture rounds, music quiz. Teams of 2-6. Prizes for winners.
events.location: Waxy's Irish Pub, Mainzer Landstraße 95, 60329 Frankfurt
